5.description: [Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Items] Applied all previously applied fixes and changes to Black Temple items to their  Heroic Bloodforged versions.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Illidan Stormrage] Added two absolutely not suspicious Fel Prisons to Illidans Battle Field.

[Pending Restart] [The Battle for Mount Hyjal] [Items] Corrected an issue where the Band of the Eternal Defender would not apply its cooldown info debuf to the player, showing the remaining cooldown on its proc.

[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Items] For limited time only, player can now find Gnarf Schnar The "Collector" at the Black temple entrance. Gnarf Schnarf is interested in trading your shiny items for his shiny items. He is currently looking for The Brutalizer, Swiftsteel Bludgeon, Reaver Cleaver and The Taskmaster.

[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Items] Three new items will now drop from Black Templer Trash mobs: Reaver Cleaver - A 1 Handed Tank Axe, The Taskmaster - A 1 Handed Melee Mace, Finkle's Vibroblade - A 1 Handed Strength Sword.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Items] Shadowmoon Insigni's periodic damage application can now be removed with effects that make the player entirely immune to it.

[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Items] The Cursed Vision of Sargeras now has a 1 second cooldown, down from 30 minutes, allowing to toggle the demon tracking effect to be turned on or off and now persists through death.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Items] The Bulwark of Azzinoth now proc at 100% chance from damage taken at or below 35% health and will then have a 1 minute cooldown.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Items] Shadowmoon Insigni's periodic damage application can now be removed with effects that make the player entirely immune to it.

[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Items] Corrected an issue where the effect of the Shadowmoon Insignia could deny pvp credits by the user killing himself through the periodic damage effect. If the Insignia would kill the user, it will now leave the user 1 health point.

[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Items] Corrected multiple issues where spell proc and use effects would give no information on their active auras on how much of a stat they increased or how much damage they inflict. Effects that inflict damage or healing now calculate spell and attackpower on their effect tooltipps.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Items] Corrected an issue where The Black Bow of the Betrayer would not grant ranged attack power.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Items] Corrected an issue where the Momento of Tyrande would apply its effect to the entire raidgroup.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Items] Corrected an issue where the Siphon of the Nathrezim would not proc on heroic and higher difficulties.

[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Items] Corrected an issue where the following items had no upscalled or differencing effects between difficulties, Crystal Spire of Karabor, Siphon of the Nathrezim, Tome of the Lightbringerr, Totem of Ancestral Guidance, Idol of the White Stag, Bulwark of Azzinoth.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Items] Corrected several issues where bloodforging a number of items would turn them into different items.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Items] Corrected several issues where the Bloodforged version of a number of items had different stats then their normal version.

[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Items] Corrected several issues where the Heroic, Mythic and Ascended version of a number of items had different stats then their normal version. Effected items are: Felstone Bullwark, Girdle of the Light Bearer, Gloves of Unfailing Faith, Grips of Damnation, Illidari Runeshield, Pillagers Gauntlets, Shard of Azzinoth, Softstep Boots of Tracking, Swiftsteel Bludgeon, Syphon of the Nathrezim, The Brutalizer, Treads of the Den Mother, Nature Wardens Treads.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Items] Corrected several issues where items were missing socket slots, socket boni and pvePower.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Items] Rising Tide is no longer unique equipped and player are now able to wield two Rising Tides at the same time.

[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Items] Corrected several issues where items had a limit 1 restriction, preventing player from having more then one copy of an item on their character, preventing the item from being distributed.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Items] Corrected several issues where items would not diplay the correct item level for their drop source. This doesn't effect their stat values.
